control_1.xSQL:
select Count(*) from xc_business_groups
WHERE
(
  :v_search_name is null
  OR
  Lowercase(name) LIKE Lowercase(Concat('%',:v_search_name,'%'))
)

control_2.xSQL:
select xc.earning_group_name, xc.customer_name, xc.credit_type_id, xc.order_code, xc.item_code, xc.incentive_date, mtd_credit_amount,  mtd_commission_amount,   mtd_held, case when is_held = 0 then mtd_commission_amount else mtd_released end mtd_released, customer_number, customer_po_number, product_name, descr, geography_name, incentive_date, fl_id,  rate_amount_clean,  rate_amount, is_held from (
select xc.earning_group_name, xc.customer_name, xc.credit_type_id, xc.order_code, xc.item_code, xc.incentive_date, FormatNumber(xcr.amount, '###,##0.00')  mtd_credit_amount, FormatNumber(Sum(xc.amount), '###,##0.00')  mtd_commission_amount, FormatNumber(Sum(xc.held_amount), '###,##0.00')  mtd_held, FormatNumber(Sum(xc.released_amount), '###,##0.00')  mtd_released, customer_number, customer_po_number, product_name, descr, geography_name, incentive_date, fl_id, max(rate_amount) rate_amount_clean, FormatNumber(rate_amount_clean,'#0.00##') || ' %' rate_amount, is_held
from xactly.xc_commission xc 
   inner join xactly.xc_credit xcr on xc.customer_name = xcr.customer_name and xc.credit_type_id = xcr.credit_type_id and xc.order_code = xcr.order_code  and xc.item_code = xcr.item_code
   inner join xactly.xc_comp_order_item oi on xcr.order_code = oi.order_code and xcr.item_code = oi.item_code
 where 
  xc.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id --'29501692543'
  and xc.period_name = :v_current_period
  and (:v_period_detail = 'Monthly')
  and xc.customer_name = :v_customer_name
  and (earning_Group_name = :v_earning_detail or :v_earning_detail = 'Monthly' or :v_earning_detail = 'All') )

control_3.xSQL:
select c_period.name, c_period_q.name as q_period, c_period_y.name y_name
	from xactly.xc_period c_period 
    	inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_q on c_period.parent_period_id = c_period_q.period_id 
        inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_y on c_period_q.parent_period_id = c_period_y.period_id
where c_period.name = :v_current_period"
"select 
	case when earning_Group_name like '%Bonus%' then 'BONUS' 
    	when earning_Group_name like '%Adjustment%' or src_type = 'MANUAL_PAYMENT' THEN 'ADJUSTMENTS' 
        when earning_group_name = 'MBO' then 'MBO' 
        else 'BOOKED AND RELEASED IN ' || :v_current_quarter 
	end component_name
	, case when earning_Group_name like '%Bonus%' then 2 
    	when earning_Group_name like '%Adjustment%' or src_type = 'MANUAL_PAYMENT' THEN 4 
        when earning_group_name = 'MBO' then 3 
        else 1 
    end ord
    ,Sum(amount) sum_amount_clean
    ,FormatNumber(sum_amount_clean,'#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)') sum_amount 
from xactly.xc_payment p1 
	inner join xactly.xc_period c_period on p1.period_id = c_period.period_id
    inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_q on c_period.parent_period_id = c_period_q.period_id
where 
	participant_id = :v_master_participant_id 
    and c_period_q.name = LookupPeriodName(incentive_date,'QUARTERLY') 
    and c_period_q.name  = :v_current_quarter
    and c_period.end_date <= (select end_date from xactly.xc_period where name = :v_current_period)
union
select  
	'RELEASED FROM PRIOR QUARTERS OF ' || LookupPeriodName(c_period.start_date,'YEARLY') component_name
    , 5 ord
    ,Sum(amount) sum_amount_clean
    , FormatNumber(sum_amount_clean,'#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)') sum_amount 
from xactly.xc_payment p1 
	inner join xactly.xc_period c_period on p1.period_id = c_period.period_id
    inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_q on c_period.parent_period_id = c_period_q.period_id
    inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_y on c_period_q.parent_period_id = c_period_y.period_id
where 
	participant_id = :v_master_participant_id 
    and c_period_y.name = LookupPeriodName(incentive_date,'YEARLY') 
    and c_period_q.name  = :v_current_quarter 
    and c_period_q.name <> LookupPeriodName(incentive_date,'QUARTERLY') 
    and c_period.end_date <= (select end_date from xactly.xc_period where name = :v_current_period)
union
(select  
 	'RELEASED FROM PRIOR YEARS' component_name
 	,6 ord
 	,Sum(amount) sum_amount_clean
 	,FormatNumber(sum_amount_clean,'#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)') sum_amount
 from xactly.xc_payment p1 
 	inner join xactly.xc_period c_period on p1.period_id = c_period.period_id
    inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_q on c_period.parent_period_id = c_period_q.period_id
 	inner join xactly.xc_period c_period_y on c_period_q.parent_period_id = c_period_y.period_id
 where 
 	participant_id = :v_master_participant_id 
 	and c_period_y.name <> LookupPeriodName(incentive_date,'YEARLY') 
 	and c_period_q.name  = :v_current_quarter 
 	and c_period.end_date <= (select end_date from xactly.xc_period where name = :v_current_period)
  union select 'NO PAYMENT', 7 ord, null from Empty() limit 1)

order by ord
